reviewer: Independent known-key-analysis agent for IceKylin and GPT-6 Astra
scope: CPU-light read-only review of the alternative_attack portable suite. No sustained stochastic optimizer was run.
successful_checks: All ten synthetic fixtures reproduce every received coordinate under their construction keys.

All four stored control certificates reproduce their exact plaintexts and mismatch positions independently; the fresh wildcard-stage failure is precisely second-part source index 67, and both exact-domain outputs preserve all 225 observed coordinates.
The K16 length-class count is C(16,4)*C(12,4)=900900; its exact matching objectives are explicitly relaxed and do not constitute a complete-key bound.
The K18 length-class count is C(18,6)=18564; the fixed-pairing order count is 3!*6!=4320 and orientation count is 2**8=256 after global coordinate-transpose equivalence.
Both K18 diagnostic input pairings include all nine true unordered pairs with the correct long/short classes.
Independent IC2, IC3 and profile calculations at both true keys and twelve top/cutoff retained candidates agree within 2.35e-11.

Canonical comparison under global pair reversal confirms the original K18 true key is absent from all retained top 2000 lists; the fresh oracle pairing has true-key ranks 1259 and 589 in the reported metrics.
Freshly compiled pair_marginal, anchored_joint and joint_domain_subsolve6 correctly reject odd coordinate-message lengths.

issues_reported_for_author_correction.detail: subsolve_marginal and pair_marginal do not store initial fitness in their global incumbent before proposals. A valid subsolve_marginal run with cell stream AAAAAAAA, one restart, one iteration and seed 0 through 5 exits successfully with no output because its only proposal is skipped. A best initial seed can also be lost before it is recorded.
